primary.method: Youden-J index (maximizes sensitivity + specificity on OOF predictions)

qwen_3b.method: Youden-J index on Qwen-3B OOF predictions
qwen_3b.note: Higher threshold reflects Qwen-3B tendency to produce shorter, less-informative handoffs → classifier score distribution shifted right

qwen_7b.method: Youden-J index on Qwen-7B OOF predictions
qwen_7b.note: Highest threshold of the three backbones; Qwen-7B produces qualitatively better handoffs, shifting the score distribution, so the decision boundary must be set higher to maintain precision

meta.note: τ* is per-backbone; do NOT apply the primary τ* to Qwen evaluations
